254:t_020:1.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Well, $n? Now do you see an adult's power?」

254:t_021:0.en:
$$コーウェン$$
「Damn you, $$流竜馬$$! Damn you, $$ゲッターロボ$$!」

254:t_021:1.en:
$$スティンガー$$
「But this galaxy is our garden! Don't think mere Earthlings can survive here!」

254:t_022:3.en:
$$渓$$
「It's been a while! But this isn't the time to celebrate!」

254:t_022:6.en:
$$グーラ$$
「...I'll dispose of the ravenous destroyers. Help me, $$正太郎$$.」

254:t_022:9.en:
$$グーラ$$
「You're still as simple as ever, $$ワッ太$$.」

254:t_022:10.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Don't say nasty things like that! We don't need to fight anymore!」

254:t_022:12.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Let's go, $$グーラ$$! We'll defeat the $$インベーダー#robot$$s!」

254:t_022:13.en:
$$竜馬$$
「We can't let them outdo us! Are you ready, $$隼人$$, $$弁慶$$?!」

254:t_022:15.en:
$$弁慶$$
「Those monsters don't know when to die. Let's finish them off thoroughly.」

254:t_023:0.en:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「I confirm all $$インベーダー#robot$$s have been eliminated.」

254:t_023:1.en:
$$田中司令$$
「And they lived happily ever after. That settles everything...」

254:t_023:2.en:
$$田中司令$$
「...Except it doesn't, does it?」

254:t_023:4.en:
$$ジョニー$$
「After all, we've been thrown into an unknown sea of stars and don't even know our current location.」

254:t_023:5.en:
$$シモン$$
「$$渓$$... Were you transported here, too?」

254:t_023:6.en:
$$渓$$
「Yeah. We were repairing the $$ドラゴン$$ and $$真ゲッター$$ after they took damage fighting $$サイデリアル$$, and it happened suddenly.」

254:t_023:7.en:
$$凱$$
「It shocked me. At first, I thought the Getter Reactor had gone out of control.」

254:t_023:8.en:
$$隼人$$
「$$弁慶$$ and I were there, so we got caught up in it, too.」

254:t_023:9.en:
$$弁慶$$
「And when we came to, we were surrounded by a sea of stars.」

254:t_023:10.en:
$$渓$$
「But it's an amazing coincidence. Around the same time, a $$時空震動$$ threw all of $c to nearly the same place.」

254:t_023:11.en:
$$葵$$
「Listen... If this is a coincidence, it's an incredible one.」

254:t_023:12.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Yeah... It's amazing that you can dismiss it as coincidence or chance, $$渓$$.」

254:t_023:13.en:
$$グーラ$$
「...But being able to accept the situation anyway is your strength.」

254:t_023:14.en:
$$渓$$
「Thank you, $$グーラ$$, for guiding us when we had no idea where to go.」

254:t_023:15.en:
$$グーラ$$
「There's no need to thank me...」

254:t_023:17.en:
$$エイーダ$$
(He has a surprisingly cute side.)

254:t_023:18.en:
$$グーラ$$
「I was merely investigating $$ゲッター線$$ and the ravenous destroyers. You just happened to appear there.」

254:t_023:20.en:
$$グーラ$$
「Yes... You could say we were guided by $$ゲッター線$$.」

254:t_023:23.en:
$$竜馬$$
「I don't know what $$ゲッター線$$ want us to do, but if they think they can move us around for their own convenience, they're dead wrong.」

254:t_023:24.en:
$$グーラ$$
「Perhaps that strength is exactly what the universe wants...」

254:t_023:25.en:
$$ロビー$$
「Prince $$グーラ$$, I've detected a new black hole signature.」

254:t_023:26.en:
$$グーラ$$
「I understand. I'll head over immediately.」

254:t_024:0.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Where are you going, $$グーラ$$?」

254:t_024:1.en:
$$グーラ$$
「...I don't remember becoming your comrade. We only fought together today because our interests happened to align.」

254:t_024:2.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Then we'll see each other again, right? We're... not enemies anymore.」

254:t_024:5.en:
$$グーラ$$
「...I don't want to see the universe destroyed, either. I intend to fight to prevent that.」

254:t_025:2.en:
$$スズネ$$
「You're right. And we're fighting for the same goal, so I'm sure we'll meet again.」

254:t_025:3.en:
$$タケル$$
「Miss $$スズネ$$ is right, $$正太郎$$.」

254:t_025:5.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「First, let's compare our situations with the $$真ゲッタードラゴン$$. All units, return to the $$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$.」

254:t_025:6.en:
$$葵$$
「I understand. I'm exhausted from searching for $n and Miss $$スズネ$$ and fighting the $$インベーダー#robot$$s.」

254:t_025:7.en:
$$隼人$$
(If $$ゲッター線$$ guided us, as $$グーラ$$ says, why did they transport us...?)

254:t_025:8.en:
$$隼人$$
(What's in this sector...? Does $$コーウェン$$ and $$スティンガー$$ being here have something to do with it...?)

254:t_026:1.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「As $$チームＤ$$'s commander, for something like this...」

254:t_026:3.en:
$$田中司令$$
「Thank you for delivering the customary catchphrase.」

254:t_027:0.en:
$$田中司令$$
「Your skill is impressive, as always.」

254:t_027:1.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「They keep fighting without losing their fighting spirit, even in a situation like this...」

254:t_027:3.en:
$$田中司令$$
「Yes. No one here would despair over an accident of this scale.」

254:t_030:0.en:
$$竜馬$$
「You're both as skilled as ever!」
